rex--no-other-option.text: Action [Exhaust, ready an exhausted enemy unit]: The next event you play this phase costs 1 resource less.
rex--no-other-option.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rex--no-other-option.deployBox: On Attack: You may ready an exhausted enemy unit. If you do, the next event you play this phase costs 2 resources less.
rex--no-other-option.officialRules: The cost reduction from Rex's “On Attack” ability remains active even if he is defeated.
rex--no-other-option.officialTextStyled: Action [, ready an exhausted enemy unit]: The next event you play this phase costs less.
rex--no-other-option.officialDeployBoxStyled: On Attack: You may ready an exhausted enemy unit. If you do, the next event you play this phase costs less.

vane--quarrelsome-pirate.text: Action [Exhaust, defeat a friendly upgrade]: Deal 2 damage to a base.
vane--quarrelsome-pirate.rules: A friendly upgrade is any upgrade you put into play or any token upgrade on a friendly unit.
vane--quarrelsome-pirate.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
vane--quarrelsome-pirate.deployBox: On Attack: You may defeat a friendly upgrade. If you do, deal 2 damage to the defending unit or a base.
vane--quarrelsome-pirate.officialRules: A friendly upgrade is any upgrade you put into play or any token upgrade on a friendly unit.
vane--quarrelsome-pirate.officialTextStyled: Action [, defeat a friendly upgrade]: Deal 2 damage to a base.
vane--quarrelsome-pirate.officialDeployBoxStyled: On Attack: You may defeat a friendly upgrade. If you do, deal 2 damage to the defending unit or a base.

han-solo--i-got-a-really-good-feeling.text: Action [Exhaust, defeat a friendly token]: Deal 1 damage to a unit.
han-solo--i-got-a-really-good-feeling.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
han-solo--i-got-a-really-good-feeling.deployBox:
Saboteur (When this unit attacks, ignore Sentinel and defeat the defender's Shields.)
On Attack: Defeat any number of friendly tokens. Deal damage to a unit equal to the number of tokens defeated this way.
han-solo--i-got-a-really-good-feeling.officialTextStyled: Action [, defeat a friendly token]: Deal 1 damage to a unit.
han-solo--i-got-a-really-good-feeling.officialDeployBoxStyled:
Saboteur (When this unit attacks, ignore Sentinel and defeat the defender's Shields.)

On Attack: Defeat any number of friendly tokens. Deal damage to a unit equal to the number of tokens defeated this way.

tobias-beckett--people-are-predictable.text: Action [Exhaust]: Choose a friendly unit. An opponent takes control of it. If they do, create a Credit token.
tobias-beckett--people-are-predictable.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
tobias-beckett--people-are-predictable.deployBox: When Deployed: Defeat any number of units you own but don't control. For each unit defeated this way, create a Credit token and draw a card.
tobias-beckett--people-are-predictable.officialRules: If there are multiple opponents, the controlling player chooses which one will be “an opponent.”
tobias-beckett--people-are-predictable.officialTextStyled: Action []: Choose a friendly unit. An opponent takes control of it. If they do, create a Credit token.
tobias-beckett--people-are-predictable.officialDeployBoxStyled: When Deployed: Defeat any number of units you own but don't control. For each unit defeated this way, create a Credit token and draw a card.

jabba-the-hutt--wonderful-human-being.text: Action [1 resource, Exhaust]: A friendly damaged unit deals 1 damage to an enemy unit. If the friendly unit has 3 or more damage on it, it deals 2 damage instead.
jabba-the-hutt--wonderful-human-being.rules: Jabba's ability triggers when a friendly unit is dealt combat damage or non-combat damage.
jabba-the-hutt--wonderful-human-being.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
jabba-the-hutt--wonderful-human-being.deployBox: When another friendly unit is dealt damage and survives: You may have that unit deal that much damage to an enemy unit. Use this ability only once each round.
jabba-the-hutt--wonderful-human-being.officialRules: Jabba's ability triggers when a friendly unit is dealt combat damage or non-combat damage.
jabba-the-hutt--wonderful-human-being.officialTextStyled: Action [, ]: A friendly damaged unit deals 1 damage to an enemy unit. If the friendly unit has 3 or more damage on it, it deals 2 damage instead.
jabba-the-hutt--wonderful-human-being.officialDeployBoxStyled: When another friendly unit is dealt damage and survives: You may have that unit deal that much damage to an enemy unit. Use this ability only once each round.

jango-fett--concealing-the-conspiracy.text: When a friendly unit deals damage to an enemy unit: You may exhaust this leader. If you do, exhaust that enemy unit.
jango-fett--concealing-the-conspiracy.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
jango-fett--concealing-the-conspiracy.deployBox: When a friendly unit deals damage to an enemy unit: You may exhaust that unit.
jango-fett--concealing-the-conspiracy.officialTextStyled: When a friendly unit deals damage to an enemy unit: You may exhaust this leader. If you do, exhaust that enemy unit.
jango-fett--concealing-the-conspiracy.officialDeployBoxStyled: When a friendly unit deals damage to an enemy unit: You may exhaust that unit.
